Game Overview

At its heart, Tommy and the Fire is a adventure game about race against time in "Tommy and the Fire" where speed meets danger. Navigate intricate courses using deft agility to outpace a relentless blade. Master precise timing and strategic planning to overcome escalating challenges. How long can you survive this exhilarating, high-stakes race?
